cards.scope: Complete the XLM parity and threat model
cards.evidenceText: Design decision: use one Stellar account per vault, funded and activated by the user's wallet through CreateAccount. Connected-wallet support remains to verify. XRC source can represent XLM/USD; its generic defaults include received-rate floor 3 and freshness up to 120 seconds, but live XLM source quorum and quote are unverified. The read-only IC connector refused the backend because its service-discoverability manifest is missing; the direct XRC sample is a paid update and was not called. Do not infer oracle readiness or activation. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is the Horizon target, but provider selection is unresolved and the quorum is not implemented. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. None is validated or provisioned. Research notes SDF rolling one-year history and Blockdaemon about 100 days. Separately, a read-only mainnet XRP config check on 2026-10-27 returned Active, a $30,000 debt ceiling (3,000,000,000,000 e8s), and an explicit Linear rate curve. Decoded live values are a 128% borrow threshold, 117% liquidation ratio, 7.5% liquidation bonus, 0.2% borrowing fee, 1.5% base APR, and 132.266666666666666624% recovery target. Those differ from the XRP source constructor's $2,500 ceiling and 150%/133%/12% parameters; do not present constructor values as current live parity. XRP evidence only; no XLM registration, deployment, or live config is proved.

cards.scope: Build the Stellar rail and independent address and transaction vectors
cards.evidenceText: Commit 96c55211 adds a source-only account-to-exact-ledger reserve binding. The last focused `chains::stellar` Cargo suite passed 34/34 and deposit-state migration test passed 1/1 before the final 10B cycle-budget edit, route change 011c0b72, reserve-binding commit, and latest route commit 6da8cd46; Cargo tests/build have not rerun because the shared build slot is reserved. The read-only Latest-Ledger transform processes moving data with a consensus/availability concern, and current code still asserts one provider. A 2-of-3 independent provider-result quorum is only a target. SDF public Horizon, Tatum authenticated Horizon, and Blockdaemon authenticated Horizon are unvalidated, unprovisioned research candidates; Ankr is a fourth candidate. History notes are rolling one year for SDF and about 100 days for Blockdaemon. Wrappers have made no actual Horizon outcall, and stored deposit/receipt maps are not used by a live flow. Snapshot consistency also remains unresolved. No vault/deposit/claim lifecycle, XLM registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.scope: Add stable state and an XLM launch guard
cards.evidenceText: A source scaffold adds a Frozen NativeXlm config constructor that clones risk/curve fields from a supplied current XRP config, sets XLM to 7 decimals and a 1 XLM minimum, and clears observations. State config tests passed 2/2 and legacy custody decode passed 1/1 before the latest route/reserve-binding changes. Generic update_collateral_config rejects both the canonical XLM key and NativeXlm. Persistent serde-defaulted XlmPendingDeposit state and a permanent `(tx hash, operation id)` receipt map were added; their CBOR round-trip/old-snapshot default test passed 1/1. Commit 96c55211 source-only binds reserve reads to the account's exact observed ledger; this change has not been cargo-tested. An independent read-only review found no stable-upgrade blocker but noted these maps are unused by a live deposit flow. Config remains Frozen; XLM is not registered, deployed, or admitted as collateral.

cards.scope: Implement verified XLM deposits and borrowing
cards.evidenceText: Commit 011c0b72 adds source-reviewed fail-closed guards for generic ICRC open/add/sweep, redemption candidates, Stability Pool quote/write-down, and main generic SP/3USD/bot entrypoints via is_native_external; dedicated XRP claim/absorb paths are untouched. Commit 6da8cd46 adds fail-closed handling to unsupported XLM close/withdraw/manual-liquidation routes. Cargo tests/build have not rerun after the latest source change. WP3 remains blocked because no XLM deposit/borrow endpoint or lifecycle exists; the current Frozen config and generic update denial keep XLM unreachable. No XLM admission is proved.

cards.scope: Implement XLM claims, exits, and liquidation handling
cards.evidenceText: Commit 6da8cd46 adds source-reviewed fail-closed handling for unsupported XLM withdrawal, close, and manual-liquidation routes; these routes reject XLM instead of falling through to ICRC. WP4 remains blocked because no supported XLM claim, withdrawal, close, or liquidation payout lifecycle exists. Frozen config and generic update denial prevent XLM admission now. The new route guards are source-only evidence; Cargo tests/build have not rerun after the change.

cards.scope: Integrate Candid, user flows, and operator monitoring
cards.evidenceText: Candid regeneration passed with `RUMI_REGEN_DID=1 cargo +1.92.0 test --locked -p rumi_protocol_backend --bin rumi_protocol_backend check_candid_interface_compatibility -- --exact --nocapture`; `scripts/regenerate-declarations.sh rumi_protocol_backend` ran, and the non-regeneration compatibility test passed. No XLM vault, deposit, withdrawal, or claim endpoints or user flows are present. Keep interface and lifecycle work in progress.

cards.scope: Validate the rail with tests, independent review, and Stellar testnet evidence
cards.evidenceText: The last focused `chains::stellar` Cargo suite passed 34/34 and deposit-state migration test passed 1/1 before the final 10B cycle-budget edit, commits 011c0b72 and 6da8cd46, and account-to-exact-ledger reserve-binding commit 96c55211. Cargo tests/build have not rerun after these source changes because the shared build slot is reserved. Latest-Ledger transform consensus availability with moving data remains a concern; current code still asserts one provider. SDF, Tatum, and Blockdaemon are unvalidated/unprovisioned provider candidates, Ankr is a fourth; the target is 2-of-3, provider selection unresolved. Independent review found no confirmed XRP regression, and V2 resume exact-journal continuation is unchanged. New unsupported XLM payout routes fail closed at source level, but no supported XLM lifecycle exists. Snapshot consistency and live XLM/USD quorum remain unverified. No registration, deployment, or collateral admission is proved.

cards.scope: Prepare deployment, configuration, and activation evidence
cards.evidenceText: Blocked until implementation, exact-head review and CI, artifact verification, audit disposition, rollback and monitoring plans, and current Stellar oracle quorum, reserve, fee, provider, and key checks are evidenced. XRC XLM/USD live quorum is unproven. Deployment and activation remain separate proof points from signing, broadcasting, and moving funds.
